q30.

Memo lifecycle events that dispatch webhooks (all in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`):

- `memos.memo.created`: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` (calls internal `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) — invoked from `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`
- `memos.memo.updated`: `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` (calls internal `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:67`
- `memos.memo.deleted`: `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` (calls internal `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) — invoked from `DeleteMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:562`
- `memos.memo.comment.created`: `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` (has its own inline dispatch loop, not routed through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`) — invoked from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:119`

All four ultimately converge on the same delivery point: each builds a `webhook.WebhookRequestPayload` and calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`), which enqueues onto the shared `asyncPostQueue`. Worker goroutines started in `webhook.go`'s `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-55`) drain that queue and call `webhook.Post(payload)` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:120`), which performs the actual signed HTTP POST to the webhook URL via the SSRF-guarded `safeClient`.

So the true single point of convergence for all four events is `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`, reached asynchronously through `webhook.PostAsync` → `asyncPostQueue` → worker goroutine → `Post`.
